_comment: Kitchen fridge (LG LTCS20020B), dual-compartment. Started 2026-07-21 with AUTHORITATIVE nameplate + DECIDED firmware constants only. Measured fields (electrical/thermal/duty) are null pending a fresh equilibrated capture; the 2026-07-19/20 run was a shakedown (see provenance). Fill measured values from that capture per schema.json.

identity.capacity: product code GM-U552SOXM.AWBCNAO; 29.9(W) x 33.9(D) x 66.1(H) in
identity.compressor_type: inverter, variable-speed (LG smart inverter; noted elsewhere as linear/BLDC — CONFIRM)
identity.control: adaptive defrost: initiates every 7-50 accumulated COMPRESSOR run-hours (service manual); ~3-min compressor lockout
identity.notes: nameplate_current_a (2.7 A) here is the WHOLE-UNIT RATED MAX at 115 V/60 Hz, not locked-rotor and not run current. Run current is compressor-class (~0.7 A). The 2.7 A ceiling is the basis for overcurrent_trip_a (set ~30% above it). Confirmed the unit never legitimately exceeds it in any mode incl. defrost (observed ~2.4 A defrost-entry peak sits just under).

factory_spec._comment: From the interior rating plate (photographed 2026-07-21). Not an EnerGuide/performance sticker; this is the nameplate.
factory_spec.notes: Defrost 198 W ~= 1.7 A @ 115 V, matching the observed ~1.9 A settled defrost draw. Icemaker heater line is blank (no icemaker heater load). See docs/todo.md P0 (confirmed root cause) for how these numbers closed the overnight-overcurrent diagnosis.

channel_binding.comment: As targeted by characterize_load.ino during the 2026-07-19/20 shakedown. 0-indexed array vs 1-indexed physical label is the recurring snare -- BOTH stated. Physical-socket identity NOT yet verified (open item).

running_current_a.source: pre-event baseline of the 2026-07-19/20 shakedown current trace
running_current_a.notes: Variable-speed inverter: ~0.75 A steady near setpoint, but ~1.5 A during pulldown/recovery (box warm, e.g. post-defrost 2026-07-21). SUPERSEDE with settled values from the fresh capture.

inrush_peak_a.notes: WARNING: 10Hz/100ms-RMS sampling cannot resolve true inrush; any value is method-limited, not a surge peak.

plateau_a.notes: Inverter compressor: expect a smooth ramp, not a PTC shelf.

control_constants.comment: Scale off MEASURED running_current_a, never nameplate. overcurrent trip is anchored to the 2.7 A whole-unit nameplate ceiling for this load.

start_confirm_a.basis: ~half of running current, above noise floor (~0.10A).

stop_a.basis: below run, above noise, below start_confirm for hysteresis.

start_debounce_ms.basis: sustained above start_confirm confirms real run vs stall.

max_offer_ms.basis: policy: satisfied box shows only noise -> release slot.

min_off_ms.basis: anti-short-cycle + ~3-min compressor cooldown/lockout, survives resets. Firmware startup hold-off AND overcurrent auto-retry both reuse this.

overcurrent_trip_a.basis: ~30% above the 2.7 A whole-unit nameplate max. Never trips on rated-normal operation (defrost ~2.4 A peak), still catches a genuine hard stall (much higher). Replaced the mis-scaled 1.5 A that false-tripped on defrost overnight. In characterize_load.ino.

overcurrent_trip_ms.basis: sustained-over debounce; ignores the brief defrost-entry peak and any startup inrush.

thermal.comment: DUAL compartment: fresh_food + freezer, one RTD each. All null pending the fresh equilibrated capture (shakedown probes were still relocating; the CSV columns even read reversed early on).

fresh_food.rtd_channel: RTD ch2 -> CSV column t2_fridge_f (CONFIRMED 2026-07-21: reads fresh-food)
fresh_food.notes: Column name is correct for this run. Shakedown steady-state: fresh-food ~38 F.

freezer.rtd_channel: RTD ch1 -> CSV column t1_freezer_f (CONFIRMED 2026-07-21: reads freezer)
freezer.notes: Sub-zero branch (P0 fix applies). Shakedown steady-state: freezer ~3 F; ~4 F/hr unpowered warmup during the 7 h post-trip coast.

defrost._comment: Measured live during the 2026-07-21 fresh-capture power-up (provenance below). Triangulated: flat ~1.8 A resistive draw + compressor confirmed OFF (by observation) + melt water in the drain pan.
defrost.type: sensor-based adaptive (thermistor-terminated); NOT a fixed bimetal
defrost.duration_note: ~28-30 min (ended 2:54 PM 2026-07-21); exact value from the CSV (current step-up -> drop). This = the MIN UNINTERRUPTED WINDOW rotation must grant once a defrost is detected.
defrost.signature_note: flat ~1.8 A with PERIODIC BRIEF DIPS to ~1 A (observed ~15 & ~25 min in, ~10 min apart) = the board momentarily cutting the heater to sample the true coil temp (defrost sensor sits next to the heater). Detect-and-protect logic MUST debounce these dips, not read them as 'defrost over'.

post_defrost_peak_f.note: warmest point of the cycle; food-safe (freezer well under the 40 F ice-crystal line).

defrost.dwell_note: ~7 min from defrost end to compressor restart (drip/drain + anti-short-cycle). Normal.
defrost.pulldown_note: compressor restarts at ~1.5 A (inverter HIGH speed to recover the warm box), expected to taper toward ~0.75 A near setpoint. NB ~1.5 A sits right at the OLD 1.5 A trip -> the 3.5 A rescale was needed for normal post-defrost recovery too, not just the heater.
defrost.trigger: UNRESOLVED: went straight to defrost on THIS power-up (vs the shakedown's 6 h pulldown first). Power-on-triggered vs run-hours-due not yet distinguished. If power-on-triggered, EVERY rotation re-power could defrost -> major scheduling impact. Resolve by watching for a 2nd defrost on the ~7-50 run-hour schedule this run, or by deliberately cycling power later.

duty_cycle.confidence: low (provisional, NOT for the budget yet)

observations.basis: eyeball of 3 cycles (ON ~30 min / OFF ~20,20,10 min) in the ~2 h before the overnight overcurrent event; EXCLUDES the initial ~6 h pulldown; off-windows were shrinking (frosting toward defrost).
observations.supersede: fresh multi-cycle capture at steady state

duty_cycle.notes: MAKE-OR-BREAK PARAMETER. Note ambient with every observation. ~64% is only a sanity anchor -- too few cycles, warm, pre-defrost. Rotation budget: 3 loads share one inverter one-at-a-time; sum of duties must stay well under 100%.

instruments: Arduino Uno WiFi Rev2 (ATmega4809) + ACS712-20A on A4 -- current
ESP32 + 2x Adafruit MAX31865 + PT1000 RTDs -- temperature (breadboard, intermittent)
capture_files: data/kitchen_fridge_run.csv (+ .raw) -- 2026-07-19/20 SHAKEDOWN. Current valid only for unix_s <= 1784522297 (frozen/stale after the 00:38:17 overcurrent latch); temps valid throughout.
open_items: Fresh multi-cycle capture IN PROGRESS (2026-07-21) with the 3.5 A firmware -- captured a full power-up defrost + recovery clean, no false trip; still need many STEADY cycles for the duty number.
